notes.title: La Soirée: Pecaminosa's free title update is coming soon
notes.notes:
Detective, Detective…

 
No question shall remain unanswered. La Soirée, that is the name of the additional chapter, of the epilogue where every loose end of the story will be tied up...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/b591fe6a8d0c4a2e3ecc78813263b8199c7243c4.gif[/img]

… Actually, you will be the one to close and define its last chapter: you can remain a mess, reinforce your role as a useful idiot, or do the right thing. It’s up to you detective.

[h3]Important: All owners of Pecaminosa will be playing La Soirée as a free title update![/h3]

This game's extension [b]has new areas in store for you[/b], a [b]new boss,[/b] more minigames [b](Poker and Slot Machines)[/b] and answers for your questions. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1669460/Pecaminosa__La_Soire_The_Epilogue/

Hurry up,

Sully might not have much time.

P.S - We’ll let you know when La Soirée will be finally available...Don't worry!
